WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
above_avg_status AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.brokrepstat,
    sa.avg_modelconf,
    oa.avg_conf
  FROM status_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.avg_conf IS NOT NULL
  AND sa.avg_modelconf > oa.avg_conf
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying
  FROM above_avg_status
)
SELECT 
  aas.brokrepstat,
  aas.avg_modelconf,
  aas.avg_modelconf - aas.avg_conf,
  aas.avg_modelconf / qm.mean_qualifying
FROM above_avg_status aas
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
WHERE qm.mean_qualifying IS NOT NULL
